name: ndvi-outlook
purpose: What-if outlook of cropland greenness under a rainfall, temperature and ENSO scenario, with a range.
label: seasonal peak NDVI on cropland, as a percentage of the cell's own normal

held_out_metrics.rule_fixed_before_training: Leave one whole year out. The model works only if the pooled pinball loss is at least 5 % lower than climatology, the skill is positive in at least 60 % of the years, and it is positive in at least one El Nino year and one La Nina year.

limits: Predicts NDVI, not yield. NDVI says how green the cropland got, not how much it produced.
Experimental. It does not replace the fixed rules of /v1/simulate.
Cells of about 5 km mix many fields and crops. It says nothing about one parcel.
Rainfall of the same season is an input: this is a what-if tool, not a forecast.
Rows of one year share the weather. About 25 years means few independent samples.
Peak NDVI of dense vegetation saturates, so wet years are told apart poorly.
The cropland map is from 2021 and is used for every year.
Decision support only. A local agronomist must review any action taken from it.
acceptance: The project owner accepted limited use on 2026-11-15 (ADR 0005). The skill rule fixed before training was not met: the verdict above stays as measured.
